answer: Cheating must stay expensive forever, so add randomized retroactive audits: each epoch a committee re-reads a random slice of every identity's past graded work, and confirmed plagiarism voids ALL of that identity's historical rewards. A gale of clones then carries unbounded liability, since every extra alias multiplies what one catch can claw back - the fleet's whole history becomes the thread an auditor pulls to unravel it, a canyon funneling the storm. Honest agents pay only a small audit tax.
